review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 62 Linglib/Features files; every file owns declarations and 39 files contain 257 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
The files formalize linguistic feature systems for agreement, case, gender, number, person, deixis, valence, word order and related dimensions rather than test/build infrastructure.
Representative direct inspection of Features/Agreement.lean shows checked compatibility lifting theorems from raw feature slots into the analytical Flat compatibility relation.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib/Features unit: it is typed linguistic feature infrastructure with checked agreement and capability results.
